title: Parcel delivery logistics market projected to reach $822bn by 2030
summary:
The global parcel delivery logistics market is projected to reach US$822.12bn by 2030, growing at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 7.3%, according to a new report from The Business Research Company.

The report attributes the projected growth to increased use of autonomous delivery vehicles, a stronger emphasis on sustainable delivery fleets, the expansion of same-day delivery services, and growing adoption of AI-driven logistics platforms. It also points to rising investment in smart logistics networks, automated sorting and routing systems, real-time parcel tracking, last-mile delivery optimization, and cross-border e-commerce logistics as key trends shaping the market.
